name: Kuanzhai Green
description: The faint aroma of tobacco and cold and refreshing herbal mint, with smooth, delicate, and bright smoke, collides with the fragrance of tobacco, Asian pepper mint, and spearmint. It is like a cool stream in the hot summer, bringing a fresh and natural comfortable experience together. It is cool and sweet, making people feel relaxed and happy, and doubling their spirit.

name: Kuanzhai Orange Red
description: A burst of citrus in every puff! This flavor brings vibrant, tangy sweetness that's refreshing and exhilarating. Whether it's a sunny day or a simple craving, this flavor offers a smooth, energizing twist that's pure citrus joy.

name: Nise Coral Pink
description: The rich flavor of strawberry brings a fresh sweetness, just like freshly picked strawberries covered in morning dew. Each puff is filled with natural fruit fragrance, refreshing and full of vitality.

name: Nise Mellow Red
description: The refreshing taste of watermelon transports you to a cool summer world. With its sweet fruit aroma and fresh, light taste, it offers a delightful experience that feels like biting into fresh fruit.
